Open AI runs on this device. First use downloads a model and needs a WebGPU-compatible browser.

How your notes are handled

The planner uses WebLLM and the open-weight Qwen2.5 model in your browser. Your note is not sent to an AI server. Internet is needed to fetch the app and model; providers receive those download requests. Drafts and requests are saved in this browser, accessible to anyone using this browser profile. No account syncing or automatic messages.

This is a practical support planner. It doesn't assess recovery, prescribe exercise, or give feeding or medical advice. Use it to organise support for activities your clinician has already approved.
